answer: Every claim climbs the ocean of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nectar re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Reaching the timber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
